name: doll_s
label: South (front)
compose: First draw the `under` strips of the worn items, then the slots in order. When a shield is worn: cut masks.far_arm out of every slot listed in the shield slot's `cuts` (the far arm is behind the shield), and right after the shield draw every earlier slot again clipped to masks.near_arm (the sword arm is in front of the shield). When headgear is worn, cut its `hides` mask out of the head layer (hair that would poke through).
recolor: A piece with `tones` can take any material colour: for each frame, pixels of its tone map (grey 0/60/120/180/240 = tone 0..4, highlight to deepest) take tone k of a 5-colour ramp; tone 2 is the material colour itself. `materials` lists ready ramps.
